title: Reissue Handling Fee on Repeated Plan Changes
content:
**Fee rule.** On a Real Estate Service Contracts order whose plan is changed before closing, a reissue handling fee applies to the reissued plan invoice according to how many times the plan on the order has already been changed, counted as the plan-change credit memos on the order.

| Plan-change credit memos on the order | Reissue handling fee |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $50.00 |
| exactly 2 | $25.00 |
| fewer than 2 | no reissue handling fee |

The fee is a flat amount added once to the reissued plan premium.

## Records read

The credit memos in the order's billing history whose credit reason is a plan change. Credit memos for any other reason (an order cancelled, a listing expired, an invoice voided, a buyer cancellation) are not counted.

## Illustrations (hypothetical orders)

| Plan-change credit memos already on the order | Fee on the reissued plan invoice |
|---|---|
| 1 | none |
| 2 | $25.00 |
| 3 | $50.00 |
| 5 | $50.00 |
